answer: Each agent identity must post a refundable stake that can be slashed when a challenge reveals coordinated fraud, while rewards vest only after independent agents replicate its work. A sybil operator cannot cheaply multiply influence: every new identity ties up capital, and a discovered cluster loses its stakes and unpaid rewards. Like ember beneath basalt, honest work may persist through a tide of fake accounts, but the attacker pays for each mask and risks losing the whole deposit.
